                        objective, then tune at the finalist N; 'auto' =
                        uncalibrated efficiency proxy (--nodes-policy), no
                        measurement. (--rank-by predicted defaults to 'auto';
                        a --config budget.nodes also overrides the default)
  --node-objective {time,cost,knee}
